text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Trainer-san. Thank you for 
giving me some time off.
choice_data_list: Were you able to get some proper rest?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I was performing maintenance on my 
horseshoes to spend some time on myself.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
They undergo severe wear and tear every 
day, so I thought I should inspect them 
thoroughly.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Besides... hammering horseshoes helps me 
relax.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seems Ikuno Dictus had a good day off.
